title: Product
description: A tradeable good in Magnate. Raws are produced by extraction buildings with no recipe. Intermediates and finished goods have a recipe.

category.description: Free-form grouping e.g. crop, mineral, beverage, electronics, apparel.

unit.description: Display unit: bottle, kg, ton, unit, etc.

baseWorldMarketPrice.description: Reference price used for import/export and initial pricing suggestions.

priceElasticity.description: Classic rules: demand sensitivity to price in the softmax (staples < 1, luxuries > 1). Realistic rules: the category (total-market) price elasticity ε of the Middle bracket at the reference point (econ-audit §4.1).

baseDemandPerCapita.description: Monthly demand per person in each income bracket. Only meaningful for finished goods.

reservationPrice.description: Deprecated (Classic rules only). Optional per-bracket maximum price; under Realistic rules a 0 removes that bracket from the market and other values are ignored (the lognormal WTP curve replaces the cliff).

outputQuantity.description: Units produced per recipe execution (per-unit recipes use 1).

laborUnits.description: Legacy labour units per execution; maps to laborPerSlot = 5 × laborUnits when laborPerSlot is absent.

outputPerSlotMonth.description: Output units one slot makes per month at level 1. When absent a slot runs 200 recipe executions a month (legacy).

otherCostPerUnit.description: Purchased materials not modelled as products ($ per output unit), capitalised at production (Realistic).

kwhPerUnit.description: Production energy per output unit (kWh), charged at the industrial tariff and capitalised (Realistic).

lineCapex.description: Production-line equipment capex per slot ($), paid the first month a slot runs the recipe (Realistic).

extraction.description: Only valid on raw products. Defines which building category extracts it and the per-slot monthly yield.

otherCostPerUnit.description: Cash cost per extracted unit ($), capitalised into the raw's cost basis (Realistic).

equipmentCapex.description: Equipment capex per slot ($), paid the first month the slot runs (Realistic).

fieldsCapex.description: Field (land) capex per farm/plantation slot ($). Informational until land accounting books it.

referencePrice.description: Pref: reference shelf price ($, CPI 1, city price index 1). Finished goods; default 1.6 × world price.

wtpSigma.description: σ: log-standard deviation of willingness to pay (default 0.5).

offerElasticity.description: θ: substitution elasticity between store offers, Middle bracket (default 5).

valueSpread.description: κ: value multiplier spread; perceived value 100 multiplies willingness to pay by e^κ (default 0.7).

attributeWeights.description: Weights of quality, brand and tech in perceived value; must sum to 1 (defaults .35/.40/.25).

incumbent.description: Attributes of the permanent local competition (defaults brand 45, quality 50).

importBrand.description: Brand floor carried by imported national-brand goods (default = incumbent brand).

retailCategory.description: Retail category matched against store formats' draw (grocery, apparel, electronics, auto, …). Default from category.

referenceStore.description: Retail building type that sizes the incumbent offer. Default: the format with the strongest draw for the retail category.

importMultiplier.description: Landed import price ÷ world price (default 1.10 raw/intermediate, 1.12 finished).

exportMultiplier.description: Export netback ÷ world price at zero volume (default 0.92 raw/intermediate, 0.93 finished).

exportable.description: False for perishables: importable but never exported.

worldMarketDepth.description: Export volume (units/month, all companies) at which the export price factor is 1/√2. 0 = infinitely deep. Default 3 × one slot's monthly output.
